keymap.title: Key mapping
keymap.voiceHold: Hold to talk — press and hold to record, release to stop. No gestures to set.
keymap.tapHint: Tap a key below to change what it does.
keymap.resolved.modelMenu: {gesture} → open the model / mode menu on the screen
keymap.resolved.modelToggle: {gesture} → switch between Auto and your last model
pending.title: Awaiting confirmation
pending.k4: K4: click = delete char · long = delete all
help.keymap.panel: Each key plays a role; the role decides what it does in each board state and which LED it lights. Pick a role here; the firmware applies the rest.
help.keymap.instance: Double-clicking a Chat key switches the Crew instance via Ctrl+N — Local, then your remote crews in order.
help.led: The dot on each key mirrors the keyboard's real light: color = state (green idle, red busy, orange waiting, blue info), blink = the gesture.
conn.pairing.title: Pairing window
conn.pairing.how: Open it on the keyboard: hold the knob → Settings → Pairing mode → K6.
conn.pairing.reason.closed: Open the pairing window on the keyboard first.
conn.pairing.reason.exists: A License is already stored. Press K6 on the keyboard's Settings → Credentials to allow one overwrite.
conn.pairing.reason.confirm_on_device: Confirm the reset with K6 on the keyboard (K4 cancels).
conn.pairing.reason.cancelled: The reset was cancelled on the keyboard.
conn.pairing.reason.busy: A reset is already waiting for confirmation on the keyboard.
conn.pairing.reason.other: The keyboard did not accept the command.
conn.cred.title: Credentials
conn.ble.title: Bluetooth pairing
conn.ble.how: Connect over USB and open the pairing window on the keyboard to pair.
conn.voice.title: Voice mode
conn.voice.empty: Hold K5 on the keyboard to talk to the Tuya agent.
conn.error.windowClosed: Open the pairing window on the keyboard first: hold the knob → Settings → Pairing mode → K6.
conn.error.exists: A License is already stored. To replace it, press K6 on the keyboard's Settings → Credentials first (valid once, for 60 s).
conn.error.cancelled: The reset was cancelled on the keyboard.
conn.pairing.confirmOnDevice: Confirm with K6 on the keyboard (K4 cancels).
help.conn.pairing: Wi-Fi, License and network reset are accepted only while this window is open, and only over USB. The keyboard opens it for 180 s after you confirm on the device, and closes it 5 s after the cloud connects.
help.conn.cred: Shows only whether a License is stored. The keyboard's Settings → Credentials shows Product ID, UUID and AuthKey as SET / NOT SET; the values are never sent to the Companion.
help.conn.ble: Bluetooth traffic is encrypted and authenticated with a key made on the keyboard. Pairing hands that key to this PC over USB only. Without it the keyboard ignores this PC over Bluetooth and sends it nothing. Pairing again replaces the key; clear the keyboard's copy with Settings → Credentials, K1 twice, or with “Clear on the keyboard” here over USB (the keyboard asks for K6).
help.conn.voice: Switch on the keyboard (Settings → Voice mode) or under Keyboard settings above. ASR types what you say into Kiro Crew. Chat talks to the Tuya agent: replies are spoken, shown on the keyboard and here, and never sent to Kiro Crew.
crew.identityFailed: Crew identity check failed: not connected, the secret was not sent.
kb.title: Keyboard settings
kb.waiting: Connect the keyboard to see its settings. Keyboards with older firmware show only volume, brightness and language.
kb.usbOnly: Connect over USB to change this. Over Bluetooth it is shown only.
help.kb: The same settings as the keyboard's Settings page. They work over USB or a paired Bluetooth link, and whichever side changed last wins. Pairing, Wi-Fi, License and reset need USB, and the keyboard asks you to press K6 first. The hardware test page stays on the keyboard.
conn.pairing.askHint: The keyboard asks you to press K6 to confirm or K1 to cancel.
ota.title: Firmware update (USB)
ota.package: File: {version} · {profile} build · signed with the {key} key · {size} KB
ota.state.waiting_confirm: Press K6 on the keyboard to install {version} (K1 cancels)
ota.state.sending: Sending {percent}% — keep the USB cable in
ota.state.failed: Update failed: {reason}. The keyboard keeps its current firmware.
ota.hint: USB connection required; updates never go over Bluetooth. Only signed .akota files are accepted, and only newer versions. Settings, keymap, pairing and License are kept.
asr.route.cloud.hint: The keyboard mic records and Tuya cloud recognises. Needs the keyboard on Wi-Fi with a License.
asr.route.system.hint: While the voice key is held, the PC microphone records and the PC recognises. The text goes back to the keyboard screen to confirm: K4 deletes, K6 sends, K1 cancels, as with keyboard cloud ASR.

asr.key.stored: Key stored in the system Credential Manager.

asr.key.where.aliyun: Create one on the Model Studio console API-Key page (Beijing region).
asr.key.replace: Paste a new key to replace the stored one
asr.local.ready: Local model ready; works without internet.
asr.local.missing: Local model not downloaded (about {mb} MB, kept in your user folder).
asr.local.unsupported: Local recognition is only available on Windows.
asr.fallback: Use local offline recognition when the cloud fails or has no key (local model must be downloaded)
asr.hotwords.hint: Used by Doubao and Alibaba Fun-ASR; Paraformer and the local engine do not support hotwords.
asr.test.hint: The test only shows the text here; nothing goes to the keyboard or Crew.

conn.wifi.title: Saved Wi-Fi
conn.wifi.waiting: Waiting for the keyboard to report its saved networks.
conn.wifi.empty: No saved networks. A network is saved after the keyboard connects to it.
help.conn.wifi: The keyboard remembers up to 10 networks it connected to, including the one set up in the Tuya app. When the connection drops it scans and joins the strongest saved network, and when the list is full the one connected longest ago is replaced. Passwords stay on the keyboard and are never shown or sent. Deleting needs USB; deleting the network in use keeps the connection until it drops. Adding a network still goes through the Wi-Fi form with the pairing window open. You can also delete on the keyboard: Settings → Saved Wi-Fi, K6 twice.
